blocks.text: JUNK REMOVAL FAQ
Commercial Junk Removal in Caledon — Answers Before You Ask

items.q: Do you charge extra for rural Caledon addresses?
a: Never — that’s a founding rule of our pricing. Junk removal cost is set by truck volume alone, so a load in Terra Cotta or Belfountain prices identically to the same load beside Highway 10. Distance, gravel laneways and long carries are all absorbed into the flat rate.

items.q: How much does commercial junk removal cost in Caledon?
a: Small pickups start at $125 and scale strictly with the truck space your load fills. The exact figure gets written down during a free walkthrough at your property before anything moves — labour, dismantling, hauling and every disposal fee included, with no seasonal or access premiums ever added.

items.q: Can you clear a barn or drive shed that's been filling for decades?
a: Happily — those are some of our favourite jobs. Old implements, seized equipment, lumber, wire and forty years of “might need it someday” all get sorted, carried and hauled by our crew at the same volume pricing. For the biggest outbuildings we’ll stage multiple trucks.

items.q: Do you work around a seasonal business calendar?
a: Yes, and in Caledon that matters. Golf clubs book us for off-season turnovers, inns and venues slot us between bookings, and farm operations clear in their quiet months. Trucks run 6AM–11PM all seven days, so the junk removal fits your season, not ours.

items.q: How fast can you reach a Caledon business?
a: Usually same-day or next-day. Caledon sits on our daily Peel-region routes, and morning calls frequently become afternoon junk pickups even at the far concessions. Call +1 647 922 5865 for real-time availability — we quote actual windows, not vague promises.

items.q: What happens to everything you haul out of Caledon?
a: It gets triaged, not tipped. Furniture and equipment with life left go to donation partners, metals and electronics to licensed recyclers, and only the genuine residue reaches landfill. Ask for the breakdown and we’ll document it for your records.

items.q: Can Caledon landlords set up recurring junk removal?
a: Absolutely — portfolio owners across the villages and Mayfield West run on our repeat schedules. Weekly, monthly or per-turnover, always at the same volume rates, consolidated to one invoice with one contact who knows every property’s gate code.

items.q: How are you 30–50% cheaper than the national junk removal chains?
a: Because we’re not a franchise. The big brands carry head-office royalties in every Caledon quote and often treat rural addresses as premium zones on top. We’re local, independent and surcharge-free — the same trucks and insurance, minus the corporate markup.
